fields.centroid_hz: power-weighted spectral centroid over the sounding region
fields.rise_s: onset to first -6 dB below peak (5 ms RMS envelope)
fields.tail_s: last note-off to -40 dB below the post-off peak
fields.duration_s: sounding length, first to last above -60 dBFS
fields.raw_peak_dbfs: float peak before the 16-bit clamp, from the manifest
